issue.title: "Routing & Navigation" plunker throws exceptions

repository.name: angular.io
repository.description: Website for the Angular project (see github.com/angular/angular for the project repo)

issue.body:
The document page "Routing & Navigation" at https://angular.io/docs/ts/latest/guide/router.html references a demo Plunkr that throws exceptions when used in specific ways (confirmed with Chrome 52.0.2743.82 (64-bit) under OS X 10.10.5; also confirmed with Firefox 38.0.1 under Windows XP). To replicate:

1. Open the demo Plunkr at https://angular.io/resources/live-examples/router/ts/plnkr.html
2. Wait until the Plunkr is loaded and running (you'll see "Angular Router", with the "Heroes" tab selected)
3. Open the JavaScript console
4. Click the "Crisis Center" tab; the Crisis Center will open (good)
5. Click one of the Crises (e.g. "Dragon Burning Cities"): the crisis will open (good)
6. Click one of the "Heroes", "Admin" or "Login" tabs: nothing changes (bad) and the console will show lots of exceptions (bad). Initial exception is:

`core.umd.js:3004 EXCEPTION: Uncaught (in promise): TypeError: Cannot read property 'canDeactivate' of null`

7. Click others of the "Heroes"/"Admin"/"Login" tabs: nothing will change (bad), and no further exceptions will appear (good)
8. Click "Cancel" under the crisis: the crisis will disappear (good)
9. Click others of the "Heroes"/"Admin"/"Login" tabs: the display will switch to that tab (good).

Guess: there's either a bug in the guards for the demo code, or the demo exposes a bug in Angular 2's routing code; I'm not far enough up the learning curve to figure out which.
